blocking_findings.finding: Personnel coverage is not bound to the real runTurn phase manifest. The positive fixture repeats one synthetic phase per turn for 188 turns, while the reader merely records the set of phase counts and never asserts expected phase names, groups, counts, or ordering beyond sequential indices.

Personnel state continuity is not enforced. The accepted positive fixture ends every turn at personnel 22 and begins the next at 21. The reader does not bind phase_end.after to the next phase_start.before or terminal actors to the final phase_end, so fabricated or dropped transitions can pass.

Presence and direct-writer semantics are under-validated. Any string is accepted as a presence enum; writer rows need only finite before/after and a nonzero change. The reader does not validate allowed presence shapes, source-specific transfer/casualty/branch operands, writer before/after continuity, or reconciliation with the enclosing phase delta.

Commander caller-pass coverage is local rather than campaign-complete. Actual mode accepts any set of internally complete passes as long as exactly five RS Sarajevo-Romanija rows exist for turns 20 through 24. It does not enforce the expected turn/faction pass schedule or full corps inventories across the 188-week stream.

Commander target-selection semantics are only type checked. The reader accepts any status string and any string actual_fitness, and does not enforce filter short-circuit progression, eligibility-to-rank consistency, selected_brigade_id agreement, local-occupation bypass semantics, or fitness plus brigade-id ranking order.

The only commander positive control is one synthetic fallback-created pass and is invoked with target coverage disabled. There are no positive controls for valid not-reached, non-fallback completion, generic all-filtered/no-brigade, or local-occupation-bypass records, so tightening the reader cannot be shown to accept production-valid alternate shapes.

Preflight-b reduces the reader gate to controls.pass plus a count of 14; it does not inspect which semantic controls ran. Therefore the green preflight does not establish the fixed-plan reader requirements.

blocking_finding.finding: The commander semantic validator applies special status semantics only to local_occupation_bypass and no_brigade. Every other status, including not_reached, falls through the generic ranking path. It therefore accepts a not_reached detail containing a fully reached, ranked, selected brigade with a non-null selected_brigade_id. That contradicts the production initialization of not_reached and leaves the fixed-plan selected/bypass/not-reached gate unproved.
blocking_finding.control_gap: The valid-not-reached positive has empty candidates and a null selected id, but no negative control mutates forbidden reached or selected detail under status not_reached.

secondary_finding.finding: 786-commander-semantics-c.cjs exports functions but lacks a require.main guard around CLI dispatch. Requiring it executes validateFile(undefined) and throws ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE. Direct CLI invocation remains usable, but exported composition/testing is not usable as written.

Personnel actor, presence enum, cross-phase, cross-turn, phase-end, and terminal continuity are enforced.
Bounded writer sources and fixed-plan transfer/casualty/branch context are validated and chained to phase endpoints where numeric deltas exist.
Commander schedule enforces 188 turns by HRHB, RBiH, RS with exact ordered per-pass corps completion coverage.
Every completion row is composed with the retained 203 full-row validator.
Commander status enum, fitness tags, stage short-circuiting, ordinals, eligibility, rank comparator, selected identity, and local-occupation bypass are otherwise enforced.

passed.evidence: Validator requires selected_brigade_id, selected_brigade_location, and derived_sector_id to be null and all six diagnostic arrays to be empty. Nine one-field injection negatives cover every forbidden field.
Fresh Node 22 require exited 0 and exported detailErrors and validateFile without executing CLI dispatch. D has an explicit require.main guard.
D delegates non-not_reached semantic checks to C; C composes retained 203 checkRow on every completion. The final packet binds unchanged reader B and D by exact hashes.

blocking_finding.finding: The nine positive status controls are not valid producer-shaped records. The fixture constructor gives every non-bypass status null selected fields and empty arrays. Production selects a brigade and populates brigade_candidates before no_sector, missing_adjacency_or_friendly_set_or_location, empty_enemy_set, empty_direct_set, all_filtered, and generic_search; derived_sector_id is also populated for the latter five, and target arrays vary by the reached filter stage. Consequently the controls prove enum acceptance, not the claimed per-status contract.
blocking_finding.validator_limit: D adds exact semantics only for not_reached and delegates the remaining statuses to C, whose special cases are local_occupation_bypass and no_brigade. The other six producer statuses still share the generic branch.
blocking_finding.impact: The requested full per-status matrix versus producer source is unproved. This does not reopen the exact not_reached or require-safe findings, which are closed.
